scope: Node.js tests of new state handler and GET reader using in-process HTTP objects and mocked Auth/snapshot adapters; not live Supabase, deployed Worker or React E2E
behavior: GET-only state handler, default disabled and isolated-test gated
Caller token and current ownership/membership checks
Read context remains usable after domain moves from source to target
Whitelisted fields, no-store responses and non-atomic snapshot disclosure
Same-origin GET does not require a manually fabricated Origin header
Client uses fresh token in header, never in query, and no automatic retry
Response context validation, normalization and bounded body-read timeout
Known production origins blocked by client factory
limits: Auth and snapshot adapters mocked in these tests
No live database, provider, cache or deployment verification
